account_financial_projection_boundary.ownership_rule: SIM/LIVE authority is fetched by mode-specific API wrappers; shared projection code receives only the selected-mode account state and never fetches, repairs, refreshes or crosses modes.
account_financial_projection_boundary.read_policy: Projection helpers are pure; ordinary reads do not create wallets/accounts or mutate funding authority.
account_financial_projection_boundary.unavailable_rule: Missing allocation provenance, stale/integration-pending LIVE state, missing fields, and incompatible currencies remain unavailable rather than being inferred or cross-filled.

api_route_consolidation.frontend_contract: Every literal frontend pywebview API route must resolve to a public API method; dynamic call(name) is allowed only with literal route names at call sites.
api_route_consolidation.mode_rule: SIM/LIVE route separation is preserved wherever authority differs; route reduction never widens a mode-owned query.

retained_compatibility_routes.activate_monitor_timing: Historical test consumer; delegates to set_operating_mode(sim).
retained_compatibility_routes.engine_import_package: Frontend + historical tests still consume the quarantine/validate compatibility route.
retained_compatibility_routes.live_view_data: Historical isolation tests consume this diagnostic LIVE-only compatibility route.
retained_compatibility_routes.set_feed_enabled: Historical compatibility consumer; delegates to update_venue_control with explicit SIM/LIVE mode.
retained_compatibility_routes.stop_monitor_timing: Historical test consumer; delegates to set_operating_mode(sim).

api_route_consolidation.rule: A public RPC route may be removed only when static repository census finds no frontend, worker, app, scanner/runtime or test consumer. Compatibility aliases with known consumers are retained until their consumers migrate deliberately.

canonical_lifecycle_authority.read_policy: Integrity reads report drift only and never repair/backfill/synchronise authority.
canonical_lifecycle_authority.runtime_rule: Scanner settlement uses the canonical boundary once; compatibility helpers are not chained by runtime settlement.

categories.command: Explicit operator/configuration/action boundary; authority writes are permitted only for the action requested.
categories.diagnostic: Diagnostic/test/integrity operation. It may observe external systems but must not repair lifecycle/account authority unless separately invoked as a command.
categories.maintenance: Explicit migration/reset/archive/package/system maintenance boundary; never invoked implicitly by a UI projection.
categories.query: Read/projection operation. Must not repair or mutate lifecycle/account/configuration authority as a side effect.

db_authority.derived_analytics_policy: Bounded compact-rollup maintenance remains allowed in Stage 04 only where the query has a documented raw/canonical correctness path or historical compatibility requirement. It is visible in the Stage 02 SQL-write harness and may not expand silently.
db_authority.query_repair_rule: Queries may report missing/drifted lifecycle or account authority state but must not create, backfill, sync, rebalance, settle, or otherwise repair authority rows.

description: Explicit command/query boundary for the pywebview API surface. Every public API method is classified exactly once.

market_analytics_ownership_boundary.operational_feed_policy: Market Analysis uses feed-only operational status. It may read selected-mode account readiness but does not traverse opposite-mode accounts or unrelated lifecycle/pipeline storage.
market_analytics_ownership_boundary.read_policy: Shared provider evidence may be reused across SIM/LIVE. Lifecycle/economic metrics are mode-owned; LIVE fails closed and never borrows SIM lifecycle values.

sports_racing_engine_projection_boundary.domain_rule: Sports and Racing remain separate operator domains. Shared helpers may normalise projection mechanics but never widen a read across domains.
sports_racing_engine_projection_boundary.live_rule: LIVE engine qualification remains decision evidence only; operator-facing Qualified fails closed until authoritative LIVE lifecycle persistence exists.
sports_racing_engine_projection_boundary.racing_live_rule: Racing LIVE execution remains centrally locked; shared provider schedule/matching evidence cannot create LIVE positions, highlights, Qualified or Executed lifecycle state.
sports_racing_engine_projection_boundary.read_policy: Projection helpers are pure and do not access DB, providers or scanner runtime.
